value.question: Our team, the Spartans, plays the Eagles at Riverside Park this Sunday at 2 PM. League reminders go out 24 hours before kickoff. As team manager, what should I do between now and kickoff to get this fixture ready?
plan: Review the team's schedule and prepare any necessary reports or communications for the upcoming match.
Ensure all team members are aware of the game details, including the location and time, by sending out a reminder email or message to the team.
Confirm with the league office that the fixture is set for Sunday at 2 PM at Riverside Park, and check for any last-minute changes or updates.
